limitations: One complete synthetic subject/start; exact replay is against the latest adaptive NDT fit, not an assertion of identical parameters to the original fixed-100k optimizer.
Full-run instrumented times include Nsight and cProfile overhead. Use the uninstrumented reference for fitting throughput.
Nested Python/NVTX wall times are inclusive and overlap; CUDA API/.cpu waits include simulation, not extra CPU or copy work.
Some enclosing cProfile counters have zero primitive calls/cumulative time. Phase totals use explicit NVTX ranges and CUDA timestamps, not those counters.
Source PC samples locate hot instructions and stalls, not exclusive wall-time costs or predicted speedups. Categories use source attribution and may include inlined instructions.
The 20k hardware replay flagged PC and warp-ID sample-buffer overflow, with zero reported dropped bytes; its sample shares are approximate. The 4x1250 replay has neither overflow flag.
Hardware counters cover actual-fitter populations at 4x1250 and 1x20000. Full-fit CUDA timestamps include all 100k refinement calls, but no new 100k hardware-counter replay was taken.
GPU monitoring is sampled every 10 seconds and records no competing process; it cannot rule out activity between samples.
